title: Project Instructions
text: Always use spaces R code. use tabs. Qualify functions package names using package::function(), except functions base stats packages. Use two spaces indentation level. defining function, place opening curly brace line function signature. Place closing curly brace new line function body unless entire function body written one line. Functions return values must use explicit return() statement. , , statements, place opening curly brace end loop test declaration. Place closing curly brace new line enclosed code. Indent code enclosed loops conditional statements two spaces beyond statement declaration. markdown cell, start code indented Example Example:
code: calculate_mean <- function(x) {     if (length(x) == 0) {       return(NA_real_)     }      values <- dplyr::filter(x, !is.na(value))      for (i in seq_len(nrow(values))) {       values$value[i] <- as.numeric(values$value[i])     }      return(mean(values$value))   }

code: if (FALSE) { # example code 1 str=paste(   'MODEL_DIMS   y <- 2020:2024;                           #--years   s <- 1;                                   #--seasons   r <- "EBS";                               #--regions   x <- c("male","female");                  #--sex classes   m <- c("immature","mature");              #--maturity state classes   p <- c("new_shell","old_shell");          #--post-molt ages   zc <- seq(55.5,104.5,5);                  #--size bin cutpoints   f <- c("TCF","SCF","NMFS");               #--fleets   END'); strv = str |> splitText() |> extractLines("MODEL_DIMS","END"); lstDims = evalTextAsList(strv); # example code 2   str=paste(   'MODEL_DIMS     r <- "EBS";     miz = as.character(seq(25,75,5)); #--size bin midpoints for immature males     mmz = as.character(seq(50,75,5)); #--size bin midpoints for mature males     fiz = as.character(seq(25,65,5)); #--size bin midpoints for immature females     fmz = as.character(seq(30,65,5)); #--size bin midpoints for mature females     x<-list(male=list(imm=list(`new`=miz,                                  `old`=miz),                         mat=list(`new`=mmz,                                  `old`=mmz,                                  `very`=mmz)                       ),               female=list(imm=list(`new`=fiz,                                    `old`=fiz),                           mat=list(`new`=fmz,                                    `old`=fmz)                          )              );     attr(x,"dmnms") = c("x","m","p","z");#--define order of dimensions in nested list   END'   )   strv = str |> splitText() |> extractLines("MODEL_DIMS","END");   lstDms = evalTextAsList(strv); }
